test_results.observation: The sealed production evaluation topology and Q&A endpoint were not available in this execution context, so paired vector and hybrid runs could not be observed.
The immutable dataset/category contract is locally validated, but category metric reports require the blocked paired production observations.
All twelve locked fixture IDs map to the exact closed taxonomy enums and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_CORRECT is marked non-failure by the implemented contract.
No paired production reports were available, so selected-improvement and no-claim records could not be evaluated against fresh run evidence.
No production report artifact set was generated in this context, so publication provenance and secret-scan evidence could not be completed.

The paired run produced exactly 50 case IDs and 100 unique (case_id, retrieval_configuration_id) records with provenance_match=true. However, 10 vector and 14 hybrid observations were EVALUATION_OBSERVATION_FAILURE, so a complete valid observation set was not available for acceptance.

The four manifest categories reconcile to 13/13/12/12 cases and metric breakdowns separate applicability from observation failures. Vector retrieval denominator is 28 and hybrid denominator is 25; guardrails are false with 10/14 observation failures, so the required complete production observation and guardrail evidence is blocked.
All twelve locked fixture IDs were emitted with the exact closed taxonomy primary enums, including non-failure INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_CORRECT.

The claim contract correctly recorded NO_CLAIM with reason OBSERVATION_FAILURE and selected_improvement=null. A qualifying fully observed pair and the clean negative-case repeat could not be completed while required observations were failing.

A content-based publication manifest and artifact_publication_id were generated without self-reference, but clean_checkout_before_generation=false and no artifact commit/publication-commit validation or post-commit secret scan was performed.

The worktree-source paired run produced exactly 50 case IDs and 100 unique pair records with provenance_match=true. Four cases (multi-11, multi-15, multi-35, multi-39) remained EVALUATION_OBSERVATION_FAILURE in both configurations, so complete valid paired observations were unavailable.

Category membership and metric applicability reconciled, with vector and hybrid retrieval denominators both 34 and Recall@8 1.0. Four observation failures per configuration kept the required complete guardrail evidence blocked.
All twelve locked fixture IDs were emitted with the exact closed taxonomy primary enums, including non-failure INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_CORRECT.
The claim contract recorded NO_CLAIM with reason OBSERVATION_FAILURE and selected_improvement=null. A fully observed pair and qualifying improvement guardrails were not available.

The publication manifest was content-based and non-self-referential, but clean_checkout_before_generation=false because the temporary harness was in the worktree; no clean post-commit publication validation was possible for this run.
